desc:
⛳ Welcome to Golf For Animals!

How to Play:
🏌️ Smash food down the lane with your golf club
🦁 Attract and collect rarer animals the farther you hit
💰 Place animals on your plot to earn cash (even offline!)
⬆️ Train at your net and upgrade your clubs, food & nets
🕳️ Sink a Hole-in-One to catch each zone's Secret animal
✨ Discover rare Mutations and Titanic-sized catches
👑 Team up with the server to beat the Gopher King boss

🎁 Join the FuncForge group for a FREE gift + 10% Cash!
👥 Play with friends for +10% Cash per friend!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for new zones and updates!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, and Console
